title: robot-detector
abstract: Find the robot arm in an image without training on that robot. Built on CNOS, it matches SAM or FastSAM segmentation proposals against DINOv2 features of templates rendered with robot-renderer. Given a dataset and the robot's joint configuration, it writes per-frame bounding boxes and segmentation masks that the pose estimators in ROBOP consume.
highlight: Ships loaders, configs and detections for six arms across five datasets, with zero robot-specific training.
